newsitem.title: USA: Credible budget deal would reduce yields - Greenspan.
newsitem.headline: Credible budget deal would reduce yields - Greenspan.

text.p: A credible deal to balance the U.S. budget would probably reduce bond yields, because expectations of such an agreement are not priced into the markets yet, Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan said Tuesday.
"There is no doubt in my mind that over the long run budget policy has a very important impact on long-term interest rates," Greenspan told the House Budget Committee.
"At this stage, as best as I can judge looking at the inflation premiums embodied in long-term rates, there is an element of skepticism that clearly is still there," he said.
He added that if a budget agreement were to be reached, "it would have some effect in reducing rates."
